t2-sentiment-agentPROOF DECK · 2 / 16

Event → decision → execution

Every step is a ledger event; the model is the only thing that adds exposure

01Trigger. Heartbeats 00/08/16 UTC and the US open; events: funding beyond 2σ, Fear & Greed extreme, open-interest jump past p99, a story carried by 3+ sources in 2h, earnings inside 24h. Cadences pre-registered.
02Snapshot. 14 instruments, every figure with its source and health; text quarantined and clustered so copies count once. Logged in full, id = content hash.
03Qwen decides the whole book. Targets, thesis, invalidation, confidence, crowd-vs-us. "Flat, with reasons" is a valid answer.
04Contract and grounding. Every number must resolve to a logged fact within 2%; an invalidation must cite a shown fact; confidence ≤ 0.5 cannot open.
05Risk kernel. Eleven guards, all evaluated, none short-circuits; a missing input fails closed for any increase. It can shrink, refuse or close.
06Agent Hub. bgc order place --dry-run, then the order with --paper-trading and a preset stop; clientOid from the intent hash.
07Reconciliation. Fills within 60s, sweep every 15 min, full history daily; a discrepancy is logged, never corrected, and blocks any increase.
08Record. Hourly marks → published page → scripts/recompute.py rebuilds every number from the log.

t2-sentiment-agentPROOF DECK · 5 / 16

Risk control · the invariant

The kernel can only reduce, and the type system refuses anything else

InstrumentRuling._only_reduce raises:
 "approved … exceeds reference …; the kernel may only reduce"
 "the kernel may never turn a side"
 "the kernel changed the weight without naming a guard"

ApprovedOrder(…, _token) →
 PermissionError("minted only by the risk kernel")
 immutable · unpicklable · hash-bound to the ruling

Every guard is evaluated on every ruling; none short-circuits; a missing input fails closed for any increase. Reductions are never blocked. A source-scan test fails if the mint token is referenced anywhere but the one minter.

t2-sentiment-agentPROOF DECK · 14 / 16

Limits, stated before a judge finds them

What this record does not show

The return is zero within noise. −0.02% ± 0.6%; seven trades; Sharpe band −15 to +8. Nine days is not a track record, and every metric on the page says "descriptive".
Both Bitget data services were down for the whole run. bitget-signal answered 0 of 7 wired tools, bitget-mcp-server 1 of 11. The crowd view came from the upstreams they wrap.
The red team is built and tested, not run on this export. It calls Qwen and runs only under an approved token budget; the page says "not computed" rather than show a stale grade.
72 venue rejections of one protective exit. Bitget Demo refused the same META close every five minutes for six hours ("METAUSDT_UMCBL does not exist"); the model closed it itself at 16:06. All 72 are in the log.
The genesis's own OpenTimestamps stamp failed on a client bug and is recorded as failed; six later heads are block-confirmed.
Two rivals are built and not run (finBERT, a TradingAgents chain), and the Playbook replica is built from policy-v1, not the scored v2.
